ca3d77f42fdeaf.s:
Consider the following about Phase I of the Veligonda Project:
1. It has an allocation of 10.70 TMC.
2. It irrigates 4.47 lakh acres.
3. It provides drinking water to 4 lakh people.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca3d77f42fdeaf.x: Phase I has 10.70 TMC and supplies drinking water to 4 lakh people; its irrigation figure is 1.19 lakh acres, while 4.47 lakh acres belongs to the broader project.

ca01cedcbce71e.s:
Consider the following statements about the Krishna River:
1. It rises near the Srisailam Reservoir.
2. The Godavari is one of its tributaries.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca01cedcbce71e.x: Both are false: the Krishna rises near Mahabaleshwar, and its tributaries include Bhima, Tungabhadra, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha and Musi, not the Godavari.

ca33624bb20d8f.s: Which of the following about Andhra Pradesh at Bharat Tex 2026 is NOT correct?
o: The AP Pavilion was located in Hall No. 9.
It was organised by the Union Ministry of Textiles at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
The Lepakshi handicrafts stall was inaugurated by K. Rekha Rani.
The Apparel Export Promotion Council was to collaborate on export capacity building.
ca33624bb20d8f.x: The Lepakshi stall was inaugurated by Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh; K. Rekha Rani led the Andhra Pradesh MoUs.

caf68835410688.s: Who inaugurated the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram?
caf68835410688.x: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the airport; GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd is its developer.

ca624806580b12.s: Which of the following pairs about the Bhogapuram airport is correctly matched?
o: Developer – GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd
Phase I capacity – 16 lakh passengers per year
ca624806580b12.x: GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd is the developer. The airport is at Bhogapuram, Vizianagaram district, costs ₹4,750 crore and has a Phase I capacity of 60 lakh passengers per year.

ca6c26bcefa9b5.s: Which dance performance at the Bhogapuram airport event set a Guinness World Records achievement?
ca6c26bcefa9b5.x: The Thimsa performance, a tribal folk dance of North Andhra and Odisha, was associated with the Guinness World Records achievement.

ca352821fb5676.s: The Kosala Nagaram Industrial Park, planned by APIIC near the Tamil Nadu border, is in which district?
ca352821fb5676.x: APIIC plans the Kosala Nagaram Industrial Park in Chittoor district near the Tamil Nadu border, with Sri City as its model.

ca504e61c5bff1.s:
Consider the following statements about APTDC:
1. It plans to introduce solar-powered and electric boats at tourist destinations in phases.
2. It has ruled out private participation through the PPP model.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca504e61c5bff1.x: APTDC plans phased introduction of solar and electric boats, and it invited, not ruled out, private participation through PPP.

ca953f99fb4d50.s:
Consider the following about the Yogandhra-2026 campaign:
1. It targeted 1 crore people, with 2.5 lakh to be trained in a five-day programme.
2. Day 1 saw 25,000 portal registrations and 50,752 people trained.
3. It covered 20 districts.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca953f99fb4d50.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; the campaign covered all 28 districts, not 20.

ca5a6f1ba230d3.s: The preliminary ICAR–CMFRI report attributed the mass fish deaths at Boyapadu coast, Anakapalli, likely to:
ca5a6f1ba230d3.x: The report indicated likely hypoxia from a Trichodesmium cyanobacterium bloom (about 380 cells/ml); bulk-drug effluent was only suspected, not confirmed.

ca51fb91d85d76.s:
Consider the following about the Clean Godavari initiative:
1. The Centre assured support for the Mission Godavari Clean Project on the lines of Namami Gange.
2. A CPCB team will assess Godavari pollution before the next Godavari Pushkarams.
3. The Pushkaram theme is “Swachh Godavari, Pavitra Pushkaralu”.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca51fb91d85d76.x: All three are correct: Namami Gange-style support, a CPCB assessment before the Pushkarams, and the theme “Swachh Godavari, Pavitra Pushkaralu”.

ca9cfddefc0821.s:
Consider the following about Andhra Pradesh’s first semiconductor packaging unit (ASIP Technologies with APACT Co.):
1. It is being set up at a cost of ₹4,750 crore.
2. It is the first OSAT centre in South India under the India Semiconductor Mission (2021).
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9cfddefc0821.x: The unit costs ₹2,387 crore, not ₹4,750 crore; it is the first OSAT centre in South India under the ISM.

caa21dde2d7f28.s: The Quantum–AI University campus at Amaravati (₹730.70 crore over 5 years) is funded through 100% Grant-in-Aid from:
caa21dde2d7f28.x: The campus is funded through 100% Grant-in-Aid from MeitY and will offer quantum computing, AI, VLSI and semiconductor fabrication courses.

ca99e740968c4c.s:
Consider the following about India’s non-GMO, high-expansion popcorn maize hybrid and maize:
1. The hybrid is not genetically modified.
2. Maize is India’s third most important food crop after rice and wheat.
3. Maize (Zea mays) originated in Central America/Mexico.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca99e740968c4c.x: All three are correct: the hybrid is non-GMO, maize ranks third after rice and wheat, and Zea mays originated in Central America/Mexico.

cab2e92210d3d7.s: India’s first integrated Underground Coal Gasification (UCG) complex has been proposed in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
cab2e92210d3d7.x: The first integrated UCG complex is proposed in Eluru district; Tirupati district hosts the Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster.

ca0e9fbd014fd5.s: The ASIP Semiconductor Project in Visakhapatnam is Andhra Pradesh’s ____ semiconductor unit approved under the India Semiconductor Mission.
ca0e9fbd014fd5.x: The ASIP project is Andhra Pradesh’s first semiconductor unit approved under the India Semiconductor Mission.

cab796acc7b04f.s: GAGAN (GPS Aided GEO Augmented Navigation), used for the Undavalli Heliport’s navigation procedure, was developed by:
cab796acc7b04f.x: GAGAN is a GPS Aided GEO Augmented Navigation system developed by ISRO and AAI.

ca7e48a33b3495.s: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu renamed the Jonnagiri Gold Mine in Kurnool district as:
ca7e48a33b3495.x: The Jonnagiri Gold Mine, operated by Geomysore Services in Tuggali mandal, was renamed Swarnagiri Gold Mine.

cacae58bcace26.s: Andhra Pradesh’s first Quantum Incubator is being established at:
cacae58bcace26.x: Chandigarh University is setting up AP’s first Quantum Incubator at Medha Towers, Gannavaram.

cac4ad86f9930d.s: With the Google Cloud India AI Hub, Visakhapatnam was highlighted as a potential ____ major gateway on India’s eastern seaboard.
cac4ad86f9930d.x: Visakhapatnam, on the eastern coast, could become India’s second major gateway on the eastern seaboard.

ca6904ddfc97c2.s: Which South Korean company is the technology partner for Andhra Pradesh’s first OSAT unit?
ca6904ddfc97c2.x: APACT Co. Ltd. of South Korea is the technology partner for the OSAT unit set up with ASIP Technologies.

cac2a544372378.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The energy sector in northern and central Andhra Pradesh was identified as the most vulnerable.
2. The target for green hydrogen hubs is 120 GW.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac2a544372378.x: Statement 1 is true. The green hydrogen target is two hubs with a combined 60 MW; 120 GW is the renewable-energy target.

ca4c78c278f4d1.s: Which pair is correctly matched regarding roles in the solar Centre of Excellence at IIT Tirupati?
o: CoE for Energy Transition, Visakhapatnam – Set up the Centre through APDISCOMs, APGENCO and APTRANSCO
AP power utilities – Academic infrastructure, faculty and research
IIT Tirupati – Academic infrastructure, faculty and research
IIT Tirupati – Funding, industry partnerships and government coordination
ca4c78c278f4d1.x: IIT Tirupati provides academic infrastructure, faculty and research; the CoE for Energy Transition handles funding and coordination, and the AP power utilities set up the Centre.

ca6b509b28e40d.s: Orvakal Drone City in Kurnool district is planned as a national hub for:
o: Drone manufacturing, R&D, testing and training
ca6b509b28e40d.x: Orvakal Drone City is planned as a national hub for drone manufacturing, research and development, testing and training.

ca07f0706041b9.s: Which of the following project–location pairs in Rayalaseema is correctly matched?
o: DRDO AMCA integration and flight-testing centre – Near Tirupati
ca07f0706041b9.x: JSW’s integrated steel plant is at Kadapa; KIA is at Anantapur, Royal Enfield near Tirupati and the DRDO AMCA centre at Puttaparthi.

cad448e9dd00e0.s: Which of the following AMTZ centre–area pairs is correctly matched?
o: CoE for Additive Manufacturing – MedTech innovation
Bharat Limb Centre – Rehabilitation and assistive technology
cad448e9dd00e0.x: Bharat Limb Centre covers rehabilitation and assistive technology; MediValley is MedTech, Bio Valley is Biotech and the Additive Manufacturing CoE is prototyping.

ca1b89292b888b.s: Who chairs the Executive Committee of Andhra Pradesh Science City?
o: The Special Chief Secretary, Infrastructure & Investments
ca1b89292b888b.x: The Executive Committee is chaired by the Special Chief Secretary, Infrastructure & Investments; finance officials, scientists and technology experts are members.

cab61733e7ae44.s: The fire accident at Visakhapatnam Steel Plant (RINL) occurred in:
o: The CCD section of Steel Melting Shop-1
The CCD section of Steel Melting Shop-2
cab61733e7ae44.x: The accident occurred in the CCD section of Steel Melting Shop-2 (SMS-2) at the RINL-run Visakhapatnam Steel Plant.

cac2d011b64ca0.s: APEX Korea, Andhra Pradesh’s first permanent overseas investment facilitation and outreach centre, was established at:
cac2d011b64ca0.x: APEX Korea was established in Busan, South Korea.

cacecc5821b11e.s:
Consider the following about the revived Kakinada Special Economic Zone:
1. Its MoUs involve about ₹1.5 lakh crore with potential for 1.5 lakh direct and indirect jobs.
2. HD Hyundai has shown Korean interest in the zone.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cacecc5821b11e.x: Both are true: the MoUs total about ₹1.5 lakh crore with 1.5 lakh potential jobs, and HD Hyundai represents Korean interest.

ca4901899f7c72.s:
Consider the following about investment outreach through APEX Korea:
1. BNK Financial Group proposed cooperation in financial services, infrastructure and innovation.
2. In the footwear ecosystem of Kuppam, Tirupati and Visakhapatnam, the Hwaseung unit is in Kuppam.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca4901899f7c72.x: Both are true: BNK’s proposal covers finance, infrastructure and innovation, and the Hwaseung unit is in Kuppam, not Visakhapatnam.

caad63557d57d1.s:
Consider the following about APTDC:
1. It plans tourism investment through PPP, caravan, beach and experiential tourism, and better food at its hotels.
2. Its board meeting was held aboard a caravan travelling from Vijayawada to Suryalanka Beach near Bapatla.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caad63557d57d1.x: Both are true: the plan covers PPP, caravan, beach and experiential tourism and better food, and the board met aboard a caravan to Suryalanka Beach.

ca2774b3e2279a.s: Which of the following about the Google Cloud India AI Hub in Visakhapatnam is NOT correct?
o: Its water requirement is about 2 million litres per day for every 100 MW.
It includes a 1 GW hyperscale AI data centre.
AdaniConneX and Airtel Nxtra are partners in the project.
It does not include an international subsea cable landing.
ca2774b3e2279a.x: The hub does include an international subsea cable landing alongside the 1 GW hyperscale AI data centre.

ca7827edbd1a21.s: Regarding the Chief Minister’s Singapore visit, which organisation–outcome pair is correctly matched?
o: Google – Branch or satellite campus in Amaravati
YCH Logistics Group – Logistics parks and a supply-chain city
UN-Habitat – Task force on AI, cloud computing and digital governance
National University of Singapore – Centre of Excellence
ca7827edbd1a21.x: YCH Logistics Group was linked to logistics parks and a supply-chain city; Google to the AI task force, UN-Habitat to a Centre of Excellence and NUS to an Amaravati campus.

ca500fd22793e6.s:
Consider the following about the City Economic Region scheme:
1. Each selected city receives ₹5,000 crore: ₹3,500 crore from the Centre and ₹1,500 crore in State loans.
2. Visakhapatnam was not selected under the scheme.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca500fd22793e6.x: Statement 1 is true; Statement 2 is false because Visakhapatnam was selected from Andhra Pradesh.

ca72ec85bb5948.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly stated about the concerns over the Google Cloud India AI Hub?
o: It involves a power demand of about 1 GW.
There was no full EIA or public hearing.
There are concerns of vendor lock-in and data sovereignty.
ca72ec85bb5948.x: The stated concern is diesel backup, not solar backup; the 1 GW demand, absence of a full EIA/public hearing, vendor lock-in and data sovereignty are listed concerns.

ca7f67fbda30a2.s: Regarding elephants in Andhra Pradesh, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Main concentration areas – Srikakulam and Parvathipuram Manyam
Areas with small groups – Chittoor, Tirupati and Annamayya
Critical habitat – Srikakulam and Parvathipuram Manyam
ca7f67fbda30a2.x: Koundinya Wildlife Sanctuary is the critical habitat; Chittoor, Tirupati and Annamayya are the main concentration areas, and Srikakulam and Parvathipuram Manyam have small groups.

caa9b03494ee51.s:
Consider the following statements about the Asian elephant:
1. Its scientific name is Elephas maximus.
2. It is in Schedule I and CITES Appendix I and is India’s National Heritage Animal.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caa9b03494ee51.x: Both are true: the Asian elephant is Elephas maximus, has Schedule I and CITES Appendix I status, and is India’s National Heritage Animal.

ca4994fcbc1284.s:
Consider the following about the Andhra Pradesh–CSIR–NGRI pact on lithium and gallium:
1. It was signed on 12 August 2026.
2. It recorded gallium concentrations of up to 1,000 ppm near Tummalapalle.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca4994fcbc1284.x: The pact was signed on 12 August 2026. Gallium was recorded up to 250 ppm; the 1,000 ppm figure is for lithium.

caccf90efd0560.s: Which ministry prepared the Shoreline Management Plan for Andhra Pradesh’s 1,027-km coastline?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
caccf90efd0560.x: The Shoreline Management Plan was prepared by the Ministry of Earth Sciences.

ca381a043a4939.s: Which organisation mapped erosion and accretion for Andhra Pradesh’s Shoreline Management Plan?
o: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services
ca381a043a4939.x: The National Centre for Coastal Research mapped erosion and accretion using 1990–2022 satellite data, the 2011 Census and geomorphology.

ca52bbd6b66dec.s: Which district–vulnerable coastal stretch pair in the AP Shoreline Management Plan is correctly matched?
o: Kakinada – Machilipatnam Beach and Krishna delta
Krishna – Kalingapatnam, Vamsadhara and Nagavali river mouths
Srikakulam – Coringa–Uppada coast and Hope Island
ca52bbd6b66dec.x: Pulicat Lake and Sriharikota are in Tirupati; Machilipatnam is in Krishna, Kalingapatnam in Srikakulam and Coringa–Uppada/Hope Island in Kakinada.

ca3b1727f1a45d.s: Kumki elephants were proposed to be brought from which State to tackle human–elephant conflict in Parvathipuram-Manyam district?
ca3b1727f1a45d.x: Kumki elephants were proposed to be brought from Odisha; Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra figured in other wildlife proposals.

ca3c31fa80a404.s: Which body manages the Tungabhadra dam and project?
ca3c31fa80a404.x: The Tungabhadra project is managed by the Tungabhadra Board; the KWDT deals with water allocation.

ca0cd1dbe2c83b.s: Under AP’s BHAVYA initiative, 100 parks are planned during 2026–27 to 2031–32 with an outlay of:
ca0cd1dbe2c83b.x: BHAVYA aims to develop 100 parks during 2026–27 to 2031–32 with an outlay of ₹33,660 crore.

cab90a68d122cc.s: In the textile production profile presented for Andhra Pradesh, the State ranked ____ in silk production.
cab90a68d122cc.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked 2nd in silk production; 6th and 7th relate to cotton and jute.

ca064e46250a13.s: Lam BG-II 2208 (Aditya BG-II) was developed by:
ca064e46250a13.x: Lam BG-II 2208 was developed by ANGRAU and approved by the National Seed Release Committee.

cad115a6451ffa.s: Which of the following wildlife and forest proposals in Andhra Pradesh is NOT correctly stated?
o: A State Forest and Wildlife Management Centre at Brahmanandapuram, Mangalagiri–Tadepalli, costing ₹27 crore
Base camps in Nagarjunasagar–Srisailam Tiger Reserve to rise from 90 to 150
Indian Gaurs to be brought from Maharashtra
Six female tigers to be brought from Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh
cad115a6451ffa.x: The proposal was for 50 Indian Gaurs from Madhya Pradesh, not Maharashtra.

caf20e39410eb1.s: Which of the following about Andhra Pradesh in the Performance Grading Index 2.0 is NOT correct?
caf20e39410eb1.x: The score rose from 578.1 in 2024–25 to 620.5 in 2025–26, with the grade improving to Prachesta, so it did not decline.

ca75604a48fb7e.s: Which of the following Andhra Pradesh allocation pairs is correctly matched?
ca75604a48fb7e.x: Polavaram got ₹8,300 crore; Amaravati ₹10,000 crore, Ports ₹5,437 crore and Road infrastructure ₹3,439 crore.

ca3714f3434975.s: Which combination correctly gives Andhra Pradesh’s capital, Chief Minister and Governor?
o: Visakhapatnam; N. Chandrababu Naidu; S. Abdul Nazeer
Amaravati; S. Abdul Nazeer; N. Chandrababu Naidu
Amaravati; N. Chandrababu Naidu; S. Abdul Nazeer
Visakhapatnam; S. Abdul Nazeer; N. Chandrababu Naidu
ca3714f3434975.x: Amaravati is the capital, N. Chandrababu Naidu the Chief Minister and S. Abdul Nazeer the Governor.

ca51570dd7096c.s: Which of the following about the Andhra Pradesh Comprehensive Family Survey is NOT correct?
o: The rural SC and ST share was 27.70%.
The urban SC and ST share was 27.70%.
ca51570dd7096c.x: The urban SC and ST share was 15.91%; 27.70% was the rural share.

ca80d42a5eea16.s: AP’s record ₹185.75-crore AYUSH plan for 2026–27 is its highest annual NAM allocation since the National AYUSH Mission began in:
ca80d42a5eea16.x: It is the highest annual NAM allocation for Andhra Pradesh since the National AYUSH Mission began in 2014.

ca19d8ffb69224.s: Which of the following Andhra Pradesh women-entrepreneurship pairs is correctly matched?
o: Chief Minister’s target for women entrepreneurs – 3.5 lakh
ca19d8ffb69224.x: AP had 35,934 PMFME beneficiaries; DWCRA loans were ₹33,614 crore against a ₹32,000 crore target, and the CM’s target is 5 lakh women entrepreneurs.

cab430372655e7.s: Which ministry launched the PMFME scheme on 29 June 2020?
o: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
cab430372655e7.x: PMFME was launched on 29 June 2020 by the Ministry of Food Processing Industries.

ca6712e29c6791.s: At the AP MSME Growth Summit, which agency received the work order for the MSME energy- and water-efficiency programme?
ca6712e29c6791.x: EESL, a PSU under the Union Ministry of Power, received the work order; the work is implemented under RAMP.

ca6747cf873387.s: The Chetana programme of Anantapur district police was Andhra Pradesh’s first such programme for:
ca6747cf873387.x: Chetana was AP’s first such programme for transgender persons, offering free training in computers, tailoring and handicrafts.

ca693620d7239b.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act was enacted in 2020.
2. The National Council for Transgender Persons was established in 2019.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca693620d7239b.x: Both are false: the Act is of 2019 and the National Council dates from 2020; the years are interchanged.

ca0619c709b3ca.s:
Consider the following about the Nethannala Sevalo scheme:
1. It provides ₹25,000 a year to 62,541 loom-owning families.
2. It was launched on the 12th National Handloom Day, 7 August 2026.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca0619c709b3ca.x: Statement 2 is true. Statement 1 is false: 62,541 families is the figure for free handloom power, not for the ₹25,000 support.

cae622066c40f4.s: Free satellite transponders were distributed to fishermen at Singarayakonda, Prakasam district, under:
cae622066c40f4.x: The transponders were distributed under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana.

caedac2b48507a.s: Which of the following about Andhra Pradesh’s Online Works Monitoring System is NOT correct?
o: It uses a single dashboard for monitoring works.
It enables geo-tagged photographs through a mobile app.
It cuts payment time from 20–25 days to about two weeks.
It tracks over 800 water supply and sewerage projects in all 123 ULBs.
caedac2b48507a.x: Online bill processing cuts payment time from 20–25 days to about one week, not two weeks.

ca62b6edf484b3.s: Under the Pillale Sampada programme launched by CM Chandrababu Naidu on World Population Day 2026, assistance for a third child is:
ca62b6edf484b3.x: Assistance for a third child is ₹30,000; ₹40,000 is for a fourth child.

ca6953dc0db0c0.s: World Population Day was established in 1989 by:
ca6953dc0db0c0.x: World Population Day was established in 1989 by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).

cac40108851884.s: The first instalment under PM-Kisan–Annadata Sukhibhava in Andhra Pradesh was:
cac40108851884.x: The first instalment was ₹7,000: ₹5,000 from the State and ₹2,000 under PM-Kisan.

ca2fcf64b89d0f.s: Under the Talliki Vandanam Scheme 2026, the benefit is given to:
o: Only one eligible child per family
Only two eligible children per family
ca2fcf64b89d0f.x: The benefit is available for every eligible child and is not limited to one child per family.

ca1586ce2c33c5.s: Justice Tallapragada Mallikarjuna Rao was selected as Andhra Pradesh Lokayukta by a committee headed by:
o: The Chief Justice of the AP High Court
The Speaker of the AP Legislative Assembly
ca1586ce2c33c5.x: The retired AP High Court judge was selected by a committee headed by Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu.

cabf40c3a570a6.s: The Andhra Pradesh–United Kingdom MoU on urban development covers Amaravati and how many urban local bodies?
cabf40c3a570a6.x: The MoU covers urban development in Amaravati and 123 urban local bodies.

ca410549d7c312.s: The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet approved what reservation for BCs in urban local body elections?
ca410549d7c312.x: The Cabinet approved 33.33% reservation for BCs in urban local body elections.

ca94df75eaf538.s: The Sustainable Textile Recycling Unit (₹4,200 crore, with a Fabindia marketing tie-up) is proposed at:
ca94df75eaf538.x: The Sustainable Textile Recycling Unit is at Visakhapatnam, with ₹4,200 crore investment and a Fabindia tie-up.

ca72e70293de93.s: Which of the following about Swayam AP is NOT correct?
o: It covers 65 traditional products from all 26 districts, made by 587 women SHGs.
It includes two fulfilment centres and two signature stores.
It was announced by Kondapalli Srinivas.
It was announced at SERP headquarters in Gollapudi.
ca72e70293de93.x: Swayam AP was announced at SERP headquarters in Vijayawada; Gollapudi is the location of one signature store.

ca87a10f749adf.s:
Consider the following about Mee Mart:
1. It modernises fair price shops into community retail centres.
2. It replaces the Public Distribution System (PDS).
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca87a10f749adf.x: Mee Mart modernises fair price shops into community retail centres; it does not replace the PDS.

ca63bb48ca28b7.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Sanjeevani digital health project has a 12-member technical committee to select the implementing agency.
2. ABDM was launched in 2022 with the National Health Authority as its agency.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca63bb48ca28b7.x: Both are false: the Sanjeevani committee has 14 members, and ABDM was launched in 2021.

ca78a638efae13.s: APCNF aims to make Andhra Pradesh a 100% natural farming State by:
ca78a638efae13.x: APCNF’s long-term target is a 100% natural farming State by 2047.

ca733cc5407b6c.s:
Consider the following about the AP State-Level Council monitoring VB-G RAM G:
1. The Deputy Chief Minister chairs the Council.
2. The Council meets at least once a year.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca733cc5407b6c.x: Both are false: CM Chandrababu Naidu chairs it with Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan as vice-chair, and it meets at least twice a year.

cae385538aebb1.s:
Consider the following about Andhra Pradesh’s urban crèche initiative:
1. MEPMA is the implementing agency.
2. Mobile Crèches provides technical support.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae385538aebb1.x: Both are true: MEPMA, under the Municipal Administration Department, implements it and Mobile Crèches is the technical-support partner.

ca15a5df54b007.s: Who chairs the State-level task force for bamboo-related activities in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The Special Chief Secretary, Infrastructure & Investments
ca15a5df54b007.x: The bamboo task force is chaired by the Chief Secretary, with the SERP CEO as convenor.

ca6e1f33a330af.s: The Shishu Maapan application introduced in Andhra Pradesh uses smartphone video to:
ca6e1f33a330af.x: Shishu Maapan is a contactless AI app that estimates a newborn’s weight, height, head and chest circumference and shoulder width from smartphone video.

cacf1d2d980f2a.s:
Consider the following about the Amaravati educational and cultural academy at Abburaajupalem:
1. It is being developed on a 5-acre site.
2. It is being implemented under the AP School Education Corporation.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cacf1d2d980f2a.x: Both are false: the site is 3 acres near the E3–N14 Junction, and the project is not under the AP School Education Corporation.

cade6c446def67.s: NAN Greenment Pvt Ltd’s approved NdFeB rare-earth magnet unit is coming up at which place in Tirupati district?
cade6c446def67.x: The NdFeB magnet unit is being set up at Menakuru Industrial Estate, Tirupati district; Gottiprolu is the Kotadibba monument site.

ca41f0d3727a0c.s: The quadruped robotic dog being evaluated by TTD for wildlife surveillance on the Alipiri–Tirumala footpath is meant to:
o: Supplement camera traps and foot patrols
Replace both camera traps and foot patrols
ca41f0d3727a0c.x: TTD is still evaluating the robotic dog, which will supplement rather than replace camera traps and foot patrols.

ca67b1b5e3aad1.s: Which technologies are proposed for TTD’s quadruped robotic dog on the Alipiri–Tirumala footpath?
o: Thermal cameras, sonar and RFID tagging
Radar, GPS collars and tranquilliser darts
Night-vision cameras, seismic sensors and acoustic traps
Optical and thermal-imaging cameras, 360-degree LiDAR and AI classification
ca67b1b5e3aad1.x: The robotic dog is to use optical and thermal-imaging cameras, 360-degree LiDAR and AI classification, with geo-tagged alerts and sound and light deterrence.

ca7e6b0b454c85.s: Which of the following about PM SHRI-related initiatives in Andhra Pradesh is NOT correct?
o: PM SHRI schools are aligned with NEP 2020.
844 smart kitchens followed the Kadapa model.
Talliki Vandanam was extended to orphaned children.
PM SHRI schools are model private schools.
ca7e6b0b454c85.x: PM SHRI schools are model government schools, not private schools.

ca973970427000.s: Along with the UNESCO proposal for Lepakshi and Gandikota, concern was raised over Amaravati Buddhist sculptures held in museums in:
ca973970427000.x: The concern highlighted was Amaravati Buddhist sculptures preserved in London museums.

ca3cfb79ce5a31.s: As of July 2026, how many World Heritage Sites did India have?
ca3cfb79ce5a31.x: India had 45 World Heritage Sites: 37 cultural, 7 natural and 1 mixed.

ca68dee2d8f5fa.s:
Consider the following about UNESCO World Heritage evaluation:
1. A site must have Outstanding Universal Value and meet at least one of the ten criteria.
2. ICOMOS evaluates cultural sites.
3. IUCN evaluates cultural sites.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca68dee2d8f5fa.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; IUCN evaluates natural sites, not cultural sites.

ca683722ec7de3.s:
Consider the following about pangolins:
1. There are eight pangolin species in all.
2. Four of them are African species.
3. Five of them are Asian species.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca683722ec7de3.x: The eight species are four African and four Asian, so statement 3 is wrong.

cafe2907b28d32.s:
Consider the following about pangolins:
1. The Indian Pangolin and the Chinese Pangolin are both found in India.
2. Both are in Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.
3. All eight pangolin species are in CITES Appendix II.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cafe2907b28d32.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; all eight species are in CITES Appendix I, not Appendix II.

ca8d14083796ba.s: The Gajapati-era Odia inscription in Srikakulam district was found under a Tulasi Choura at:
ca8d14083796ba.x: The inscription was discovered under a Tulasi Choura at the Tekkali royal palace in Srikakulam district.

cac9ad96bb7159.s:
Consider the following about the Gajapati-era Odia inscription at Tekkali:
1. Its palaeography suggests a 15th-century date.
2. Kapilendra Deva’s kingdom extended from the Kaveri in the north to the Ganga in the south.
3. Tekkali was a former Odia zamindari of Ganjam.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac9ad96bb7159.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; Kapilendra Deva’s kingdom ran from the Ganga in the north to the Kaveri in the south.

ca91ce4e95302f.s:
Consider the following about the Vijayanagara-era inscriptions found in the Seshachalam forest:
1. Three rare inscriptions are dated 1554, in the reign of Sadasiva Deva Raya.
2. They are in Telugu, Tamil and Kannada.
3. They belong to the 2nd century BCE.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca91ce4e95302f.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; the 2nd century BCE date relates to the Gudimallam Siva shrine.

ca618927f5e716.s:
Consider the following about the inscriptions found at Sadasivakona:
1. The main record refers to Sadasiva Raya’s sacred bath and royal donations.
2. The inscriptions were copied as estampages.
3. The ASI was established during the Vijayanagara period.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca618927f5e716.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; the ASI was established in 1861.

ca98b8eecdaa15.s: The 129th birth anniversary of Alluri Sitarama Raju was celebrated at his birthplace:
ca98b8eecdaa15.x: It was celebrated at his birthplace, Pandrangi village in Padmanabham mandal, Visakhapatnam district; Koyyuru is linked with his death.

cae5c378b1f121.s: Which of the following about Alluri Sitarama Raju is NOT correct?
o: His rebellion was in the Eastern Ghats and involved guerrilla warfare.
He was killed by the British at Koyyuru on 7 May 1924.
The Rampa Rebellion he led was fought during 1923–1924.
cae5c378b1f121.x: The Rampa (Manyam) Rebellion was fought during 1922–1924, not 1923–1924.

cadab633e028ea.s: Which of the following details of Alluri Sitarama Raju is correctly matched?
cadab633e028ea.x: He was known as Manyam Veerudu; he was born on 4 July 1897, the stamp came in 1986 and the film in 1974.

cae411ff2b36d5.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Duggirala Gopalakrishnayya was the first leader from Andhra elected General Secretary of the AICC.
2. Tanguturi Prakasam was known as Andhra Gandhi.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae411ff2b36d5.x: Statement 1 is true. Tanguturi Prakasam was Andhra Kesari; Andhra Gandhi was a title of Duggirala Gopalakrishnayya.

ca073e10c4f48a.s: Under the Japan Skill Mobility Partnership, Andhra Pradesh youth were placed in Japan’s ____ sector.
ca073e10c4f48a.x: The partnership placed Andhra Pradesh youth in Japan’s automobile manufacturing sector.

caae5b9f0c07f0.s: Which of the following details of Duggirala Gopalakrishnayya is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Early employment – Clerk in Bapatla Taluk Office
Organisation founded in Chirala (1920) – Madandhra Vidyapeeth Goshti
Chirala-Perala movement – Regarded as its hero
caae5b9f0c07f0.x: His volunteer force was Ramadandu; Madandhra Vidyapeeth Goshti was the organisation he founded in Chirala in 1920.

cae61301a5247f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Rottela Panduga is held at Antarvedi in Konaseema district.
2. The Antarvedi Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Kalyanotsavam is a five-day festival.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae61301a5247f.x: Both are false: Rottela Panduga is held at Bara Shaheed Dargah, Nellore, and the Antarvedi Kalyanotsavam lasts 10 days.

cab7d0b2ca1392.s: Which title was conferred on Andhra Pradesh at the Global Travel Market (GTM) 2026?
cab7d0b2ca1392.x: Andhra Pradesh was named “Best Tourism Promotion State” at GTM 2026 and will also host GTM Expo 2027.

cad244f8c12bc9.s: Which Andhra Pradesh school stood first in the Hyderabad Region in the 36th National Youth Parliament Competition (2025–26)?
cad244f8c12bc9.x: PM SHRI KV Nellore stood first in the Hyderabad Region; Dr. Rajendra Prasad KV received the national shield.

ca3148d032a8e7.s: Which Craft Wood Bank centre–craft pair is correctly matched?
ca3148d032a8e7.x: Bobbili is known for the Veena; Kondapalli for wooden toys, Etikoppaka for lacquer toys and Udayagiri for wooden cutlery.

ca95cf5703f3b0.s: The highest Sangeet Natak Akademi honour, carrying ₹3 lakh, is the:
ca95cf5703f3b0.x: The Fellowship (Akademi Ratna) is the highest honour with ₹3 lakh; the Akademi Award carries ₹1 lakh.

caf963c509317f.s: The Kotadibba archaeological site at Gottiprolu is protected under:
o: AP Ancient and Historical Monuments Act, 1960
caf963c509317f.x: Kotadibba, declared a Monument of National Importance, is protected under the AMASR Act, 1958.

cabb1086354592.s: The Undavalli Caves (4th–5th century AD), venue of the Telugu Mahotsavam, are beside which river?
cabb1086354592.x: The Undavalli Caves are 4th–5th century AD rock-cut sandstone caves on a hill beside the Krishna River.

ca8dd9e0804687.s: Which rock-cut cave site pair is correctly matched?
o: Undavalli Caves – Originally a Buddhist vihara
ca8dd9e0804687.x: Undavalli was originally a Buddhist vihara; Ajanta is in Maharashtra, Badami in Karnataka and Udayagiri in Madhya Pradesh.

ca75bc298fc2ec.s:
Consider the following about the ICAR-IIOPR MoU:
1. ICAR-Indian Institute of Oil Palm Research signed it with Patanjali Foods.
2. It aims to use rapid diagnostics to detect Ganoderma disease in oil palm before symptoms appear.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca75bc298fc2ec.x: Both are true: the MoU between IIOPR and Patanjali Foods is for early detection of Ganoderma in oil palm.

cad3d7fa148935.s: Where is the ICAR-Indian Institute of Oil Palm Research (IIOPR) located?
cad3d7fa148935.x: IIOPR is at Pedavegi village near Eluru in Eluru district.

ca31a12b6456c0.s: Which of the following about the Ordinance raising the sanctioned strength of the Supreme Court is NOT correct?
o: It raised the strength from 34 to 38, including the CJI.
If it lapses, the strength reverts to 34.
Reversion raises concerns about security of tenure and judicial independence.
If it lapses, the strength remains at 38.
ca31a12b6456c0.x: If the Ordinance lapses, the strength reverts to 34, not stays at 38.

nc53b6657b7e.s: The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026, replaced an ordinance that raised the sanctioned strength, including the CJI, from:
nc53b6657b7e.x: The Bill replaced the May 2026 ordinance raising the number of judges from 34 to 38, including the CJI.

ca4b3d07555cfe.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026 raised the number of puisne judges from 33 to 36.
2. Article 124(1) enables Parliament to fix the number of Supreme Court judges by law.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca4b3d07555cfe.x: Statement 2 is true. Puisne judges were raised from 33 to 37, not 36.

ca75a5b3cb46fa.s:
Consider the following about the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Act, 2026:
1. It is administered by the Ministry of Home Affairs.
2. Its mandatory fast-track courts must complete trials within 2 years.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca75a5b3cb46fa.x: Both are false: the Act is administered by the Ministry of Personnel, and trials must be completed within 2 months.

cac0e2a199e927.s: Under the LWE surrender and rehabilitation measures, a higher-ranked extremist who surrenders receives a grant of:
cac0e2a199e927.x: Higher-ranked extremists get ₹5 lakh; others get ₹2.5 lakh, plus ₹10,000 a month for 36 months as separate support.

ca3d5d11116c9c.s: Which e-Courts AI tool is meant for legal research?
ca3d5d11116c9c.x: LegRAA is the legal-research tool; separately, an AI filing-scrutiny tool was developed with IIT Madras for 200 AoRs.

ca4ca350675460.s: Under the harsher penalty approved for paper leaks, the maximum fine and imprisonment are:
ca4ca350675460.x: The amendment provides fines up to ₹10 crore and imprisonment up to 10 years for paper leaks.

cafdedd3570243.s: Per the Supreme Court, a citizenship case the ECI finds doubtful during electoral-roll revision should be:
o: Decided finally by the ECI itself
Deferred until after the next election
Referred to the competent authority under the Citizenship Act, 1955
cafdedd3570243.x: Doubtful cases go to the competent authority under the Citizenship Act, 1955, preferably before the next election in that constituency; the ECI does not finally decide citizenship.

ca7cfe4e41b269.s:
Consider the following about the FCRA:
1. Foreign contribution may be transferred to other NGOs from the designated SBI account in New Delhi.
2. Journalists are not among the categories barred from receiving foreign contribution.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7cfe4e41b269.x: Both are false: funds cannot be transferred to other NGOs, and journalists are among the barred categories.

caf116b9a8f15c.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Right to be Forgotten is treated as part of the Right to Privacy under Article 21.
2. The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 is implemented by MeitY.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caf116b9a8f15c.x: Both are true: Delhi High Court guidelines treat it as part of privacy under Article 21, and MeitY implements the DPDP Act, 2023.

caf8aebd898a1f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Article 22(1) gives an arrested person the right to consult and be defended by a legal practitioner of choice.
2. Article 21 treats a fair trial as part of the right to life.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caf8aebd898a1f.x: Both are true: Article 22(1) guarantees counsel of choice, and Article 21 includes a fair trial within the right to life.

ca5cbc1ae612b7.s: In ADR v. Election Commission of India, the Supreme Court, on the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) before the Bihar elections:
o: Transferred the SIR to the Citizenship Act authority
Suspended all roll revisions until after the elections
ca5cbc1ae612b7.x: The Court upheld the ECI’s SIR order as broadly proportionate, holding the ECI best placed to decide the revision method.

ca2b63584055b5.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The right to be forgotten is linked to informational privacy under Article 21.
2. The DPDP Act, 2023 has settled how the right to erasure applies to court records.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca2b63584055b5.x: Statement 1 is true. The DPDP Act recognises the right to erasure, but its application to court records remains unclear.

ca3516c4289950.s: Which of the following case–holding pairs on the right to be forgotten is correctly matched?
o: Supreme Court matter, 2022 – Not automatic for ongoing proceedings
Kerala High Court, 2023 – Registry directed to remove a couple’s details from search engines
Supreme Court matter, 2022 – Privacy is a fundamental right
Kerala High Court, 2023 – Not automatic for ongoing proceedings
ca3516c4289950.x: The Kerala High Court (2023) held the right is not automatic for ongoing proceedings; the 2022 Supreme Court matter removed a couple’s details from search engines.

caaa9161d9dce3.s: Which phase of the e-Courts Mission Mode Project focuses on paperless courts, virtual hearings, AI and OCR, with an outlay of ₹7,210 crore?
caaa9161d9dce3.x: Phase III (2023–2027) focuses on paperless courts, virtual hearings, AI and OCR; Phase II focused on NJDG, e-Filing, e-Sewa Kendras and video conferencing.

cadca457e74ff0.s: In the Saptadhara framework of the PM’s 80th Independence Day speech, the Green and Blue economy was the ____ pathway.
cadca457e74ff0.x: The sixth pathway was the Green and Blue economy (green hydrogen and marine resources); defence was fifth and technology/AI third.

cadb4fd8116561.s: What nuclear-power target was announced in the Prime Minister’s 80th Independence Day speech?
cadb4fd8116561.x: The target was 100 GW of nuclear power by 2047, alongside five new reactors this decade.

ca580a32c44edc.s: Which feature of the 15 August 2026 Independence Day ceremony at the Red Fort is correctly matched?
o: Vande Mataram – Only the first two stanzas sung
PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan – 2019
ca580a32c44edc.x: The 21-gun salute used indigenous 105-mm Light Field Guns; all six stanzas of Vande Mataram were sung, the formation had about 2,500 personnel and Gati Shakti dates to 2021.

caca3e067bd544.s: Which country–foreign-influence law pair is correctly matched?
o: USA – Foreign Influence Transparency and Accountability Act
caca3e067bd544.x: The UK has the Foreign Influence Registration Scheme; the USA has FARA, Australia the Foreign Influence Transparency Scheme and Canada the Foreign Influence Transparency and Accountability Act.

ca6b66cd047b98.s: Which of the following details of Vande Mataram is correctly matched?
o: Sung by Tagore at an INC session – 1905
ca6b66cd047b98.x: It was first published in Bangadarshan on 7 November 1875; Bankim Chandra Chatterjee composed it, Tagore sang it at the 1896 Calcutta session, and it became a Swadeshi slogan on 7 August 1905.

ca9921bba1a371.s: Which of the following pairs on Vande Mataram and Jana Gana Mana is correctly matched?
o: Author of Vande Mataram – Rabindranath Tagore
Official duration of Vande Mataram – 3 minutes 10 seconds
Author of Jana Gana Mana – Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay
ca9921bba1a371.x: Vande Mataram’s official duration is 3 minutes 10 seconds; Bankim wrote Vande Mataram, Tagore wrote Jana Gana Mana, and both were adopted on 24 January 1950.

ca6f362056e593.s: According to ADR’s analysis of sitting Chief Ministers’ declared assets, the wealthiest Chief Minister was:
ca6f362056e593.x: Karnataka CM D.K. Shivakumar was the wealthiest, with assets exceeding ₹1,413 crore.

cac3aa120467e8.s: Which of the following islands has a tribal council under the Andaman and Nicobar tribal council framework?
cac3aa120467e8.x: Car Nicobar is among the islands with councils, along with Nancowry, Kamorta, Teressa, Little Nicobar and Great Nicobar.

cad5434a8122c0.s: Of the four women Chief Justices simultaneously heading High Courts in June 2026, which pair is correctly matched?
o: Meenakshi Madan Rai – Gujarat High Court
Revati Mohite Dere – Patna High Court
Lisa Gill – Andhra Pradesh High Court
cad5434a8122c0.x: Lisa Gill heads the AP High Court; Meenakshi Madan Rai heads Patna, Sunita Agarwal Gujarat and Revati Mohite Dere Meghalaya.

cad8485cac5274.s:
Consider the following about coral reefs in India:
1. Coral reefs are found in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
2. Coral reefs are also found in the Gulf of Kachchh and the Gulf of Mannar.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad8485cac5274.x: Both are true: the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, the Gulf of Kachchh and the Gulf of Mannar have coral reefs.

ca3fd7267c98cb.s: On simultaneous elections, which body–year–view pair is correctly matched?
ca3fd7267c98cb.x: The Law Commission’s 170th Report (1999) supported simultaneous elections; the EC was 1983, the Standing Committee 2015 and NITI Aayog 2017.

ca140ae52c1b86.s: Which prison-reform measure pair is correctly matched?
o: Model Prisons and Correctional Services Act – 2023
Support to Poor Prisoners Scheme – Digital prison initiative
ca140ae52c1b86.x: The Model Prisons and Correctional Services Act is of 2023; the Model Prison Manual is of 2016 and E-Prisons is the digital initiative.

cab199f43e4013.s: In the notified-disaster framework, the National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) provides:
o: The primary State fund for notified disasters
Additional aid for disasters of severe nature
Funds for long-term mitigation projects only
A fund financed solely by the States
cab199f43e4013.x: The NDRF gives additional aid for severe disasters; the SDRF is the primary State fund for notified disasters.

cac3c25039b7ed.s: Which Article deals with the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes?
cac3c25039b7ed.x: Article 338A deals with the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes; Article 342 concerns identification of Scheduled Tribes.

ca633c21eb725b.s:
Consider the following about the Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024:
1. The appointed date is notified by the Election Commission at the first sitting of the new Lok Sabha.
2. After a mid-term dissolution, elections are held for a full new term.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca633c21eb725b.x: Both are false: the President notifies the appointed date, and a mid-term dissolution leads to election only for the unexpired term.

ca8474034f549c.s: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) functions under the:
ca8474034f549c.x: I4C is under the Ministry of Home Affairs.

ca94cff1b1dd33.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Pralhad Joshi was given additional charge of the Ministry of Education after Dharmendra Pradhan resigned.
2. The Ministry of Education was called the Ministry of Human Resource Development until 2020.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca94cff1b1dd33.x: Both are true: Pralhad Joshi got additional charge, and MHRD was renamed the Ministry of Education in 2020.

ca228b815826fe.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Unani is no longer part of the Ministry of AYUSH.
2. Traditional Chinese Medicine is identified as Ayurveda’s main competitor.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca228b815826fe.x: Unani is still part of the Ministry of AYUSH; Traditional Chinese Medicine is identified as Ayurveda’s main competitor.

cac7222dd4df9e.s: The 250 MW solar-plus-BESS project on former cantonment land at Sitapur, Uttar Pradesh, is to be implemented by:
cac7222dd4df9e.x: NTPC will implement the 250 MW solar and BESS project on about 850 acres at Sitapur.

cab996ec01b55f.s: Under Section 479 of BNSS 2023, a first-time offender may be released on bond after serving what part of the maximum sentence?
cab996ec01b55f.x: A first-time offender who has served one-third of the maximum sentence may be released on bond, with the jail superintendent required to apply.

ca26be7c317aeb.s:
Consider the following about the Supreme Court committee on the SJP protests over NEET and police action:
1. It is a six-member committee.
2. Justice R.K. Jha chairs it.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca26be7c317aeb.x: Both are false: it is a five-member committee chaired by Justice R. Subhash Reddy; Justice R.K. Jha is a member.

ca52543a9a2f06.s:
Consider the following about the notified-disaster framework for 2026–2031:
1. The Disaster Management Act, 2005 is administered through the Ministry of Home Affairs as nodal ministry.
2. The SDRF is the primary State fund for notified disasters, with Centre and State contributions in set ratios.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca52543a9a2f06.x: Both are true: MHA is the nodal ministry, and the SDRF is the primary State fund with Centre–State contributions.

cae1e860838c1d.s: Which set correctly lists the six communities notified as minorities for the National Commission for Minorities?
o: Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis and Bahais
Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jews and Jains
Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis and Jains
Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Lingayats, Parsis and Jains
cae1e860838c1d.x: The six notified minorities are Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis and Jains.

cab62e412de7c6.s: In the Strategic Roadmap for Making Ayurveda Global, which measure–phase pair is correctly matched?
o: Medical Value Travel hubs – Short-term phase
cab62e412de7c6.x: Modernising TKDL and Medical Value Travel hubs are medium-term; the Global Ayurveda Register and WHO-GMP-equivalent certification are short-term.

ca72e2dfbe43a1.s: Where is the WHO Global Traditional Medicine Centre located?
ca72e2dfbe43a1.x: The WHO Global Traditional Medicine Centre is in Jamnagar, Gujarat.

ca4819b052e89d.s: Which State ranked first nationally in cybercrime control, victim services and digital platforms in the PMO-led PRAGATI review?
ca4819b052e89d.x: Telangana ranked first in the PRAGATI review; Sahyog and Samanvaya are portals and I4C is the coordination centre.

ca97a366e40dbe.s:
Consider the following about the campaign “Suraksha Ka Tiranga – Telangana Towards Cyber Swatantrata”:
1. Saffron represented “Be Aware”.
2. Green represented “Be Safe”.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca97a366e40dbe.x: Saffron stood for “Be Alert” and white for “Be Aware”; green stood for “Be Safe”.

ca0910d58f1cf0.s:
Consider the following about Samadhan Didi:
1. It is the first AI voice chatbot for CPGRAMS in 20 Eighth Schedule languages.
2. It was developed by DARPG with Bhashini.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca0910d58f1cf0.x: It supports all 22 Eighth Schedule languages, not 20; it was developed by DARPG with Bhashini.
